group_manifest.proof_strategy: Always select the left Coq disjunct of each generated witness. For entail_wit_1, open xizi_dll, apply the suffixed split helper to the sentinel-bounded segment, expose xizi_dll_links, and instantiate first/last/node_prev/node_next. For return_wit_1, substitute head/node equalities, destruct nodes_after, reject the nonempty case using the same-endpoint dllseg guard, use the suffixed reassembly helper, and close xizi_dll; xizi_double_link_next_value nil reduces to 0. For return_wit_2, destruct nodes_after, reject nil using the empty dllseg equality plus node_next <> head, obtain node_next = the head element in the cons case by one direct dllseg unfold, reassemble, close xizi_dll, and simplify xizi_double_link_next_value. Keep all helpers suffixed and in group-local case_lib; the manual file contains witness proofs only.

group_entry.grouping_reason: All three obligations use the same middle-node decomposition of xizi_dll and the same inverse reassembly of two xizi_dllseg fragments around node. Three witnesses are below the controller limit of 12, so one group is the exact minimal semantic grouping and avoids duplicating the induction helper family.

fresh_lineage_policy.allowed_inputs: current manual goals, current annotation-approved seed case_lib, xizi_double_link_common public definitions/lemmas, and Rocq official libraries
fresh_lineage_policy.reason: This retry must yield a forbidden-free repaired proof lineage.

forbidden_lemma_policy.required_method: Use structural induction on nodes_before, direct unfolding of xizi_dllseg/XiziDLL.dllseg, Exists/Intros, sep_apply, and entailer-style structured reassembly; do not use forbidden equivalence, reflexivity/transitivity, sepcon commutativity/associativity, or sepcon monotonicity lemmas.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall start prev stop last nodes_before node nodes_after, xizi_dllseg start prev stop last (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after) |-- EX node_prev node_next, xizi_dllseg start prev node node_prev nodes_before ** xizi_dll_links node node_next node_prev ** xizi_dllseg node_next node stop last nodes_after
candidate_helper_declarations.proof_requirement: Prove directly by structural induction on nodes_before. In the base case unfold the nonempty dllseg once and instantiate node_prev=prev. In the step case unfold one prefix cell, apply the induction hypothesis to the tail segment, then fold the one-cell prefix back by direct simplification/Exists/entailer. No forbidden structural lemma is permitted.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall start prev stop last nodes_before node nodes_after node_prev node_next, xizi_dllseg start prev node node_prev nodes_before ** xizi_dll_links node node_next node_prev ** xizi_dllseg node_next node stop last nodes_after |-- xizi_dllseg start prev stop last (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after)
candidate_helper_declarations.proof_requirement: Prove directly by structural induction on nodes_before, unfolding/folding exactly one dllseg cell per step. This is the explicit allowed reassembly route; do not invoke forbidden sepcon equivalence/commutativity/associativity/monotonicity lemmas.

premise_discharge.split_helper: No external premise: the nonempty clauses of the source dllseg supply node equality, non-nullness, non-stopness, links, and the recursive tail at every induction step.
premise_discharge.reassembly_helper: No external premise: the prefix dllseg supplies every prefix-cell guard and link; the explicit node links and suffix dllseg supply the pivot and remainder.
premise_discharge.sentinel_branch: node_next = linklist_pre and linklist_pre = head make the suffix segment start equal its stop; destructing nodes_after makes the nonempty case contradict the dllseg node <> stop guard.
premise_discharge.non_sentinel_branch: node_next <> linklist_pre and linklist_pre = head make the suffix start differ from its stop; destructing nodes_after makes nil contradict the empty dllseg equality, while the cons case supplies node_next = hd nodes_after.
